Container.Name: events-dashboard
Container.Overview: Personal calendar of theatre, Broadway, gallery and festival events in Sacramento and San Francisco. Scrapes venue sites and event calendars once a day, merges duplicate listings, drops sports, and serves one filterable page.
Container.Description: Personal calendar of theatre, Broadway, gallery and festival events in Sacramento and San Francisco. About 45 sources are scraped daily: event-calendar feeds where venues have them, and Claude reads the remaining venue pages. The dashboard shows a source health table so broken sources are easy to spot. An optional MCP connector lets Claude answer questions like "what's on in SF this weekend?" from your events.

Config.Name: MCP Connector Port
Config.Description: Port for the MCP connector that lets Claude answer questions from your events (endpoint /mcp). It stays off until Connector Password or Connector Token is set. Point your reverse proxy at this port, not at the dashboard's.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Stores the event database, the extraction cache and the generated page. Use your appdata share.

Config.Name: Anthropic API Key
Config.Description: Used to read venue pages that have no feed. Create one at console.anthropic.com. Without it, only feed-based and recurring sources run.

Config.Name: Connector Public URL
Config.Description: The public HTTPS address of the MCP connector port, without /mcp, e.g. https://events.example.com or a Tailscale Funnel address. Needed for claude.ai, Claude Desktop and the phone app, which reach the connector from Anthropic's servers. In Claude, add this address plus /mcp as a custom connector.

Config.Name: Connector Password
Config.Description: Asked once on the sign-in page when you connect Claude. At least 12 characters; use a long random one. Changing it signs every connected Claude out. Don't put a reverse proxy login in front of /mcp: Claude can only sign in with this page.

Config.Name: Connector Token
Config.Description: Optional fixed bearer token for clients set up with a header, such as Claude Code on your home network or tailnet (Authorization: Bearer ...). At least 24 characters; generate one with: openssl rand -hex 24

Config.Name: Extraction Model
Config.Description: Claude model that reads venue pages without a feed. Set claude-opus-5-5 for the most accurate (and about 40 times pricier) reading.

Config.Name: Re-read Interval (days)
Config.Description: Minimum days between Claude re-reads of a venue page whose text changed. Unchanged pages are never re-read. Set 1 to re-read changed pages every day.

Config.Name: Scrape Hour
Config.Description: Hour of the day (0-23, container timezone) for the daily scrape. A scrape also runs when the container starts.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone. Sets when the daily scrape runs and how dates are shown.
